<a id="body"></a>

## Body

In #311 R1 at 2e36d6a, the positive live-lapse control queued one restart, but an already-persisted lapse and a broadcast-overwritten lapse each queued none. Delivery restores a told lapse across daemon restart without repeating it, so a live-only recovery follower can leave the seat deaf permanently. Inspect the durable producer and its dedupe state together with the consumer; do not treat dropped policy input as a satisfactory safety brake. Also test lapse then heartbeat-renewal before consumer handling: the stale event queued an unnecessary same-session restart. Current-edge validation matters when adding boot replay. Keep a live-edge positive control beside each negative fixture. Private module visibility prevented the first external probe from compiling; an isolated exact-head archive with visibility-only export supplied behavioral evidence without editing the read-only worktree.
